name: Prepositions
description: Prepositions of time, place and movement, dependent prepositions after verbs, nouns and adjectives, and common prepositional phrases.

passages.title: A Busy Monday
passages.content:
My alarm rang (1) ______ 6.30, but I stayed in bed for ten more minutes. I left the house (2) ______ a hurry and ran (3) ______ the bus stop.

The bus was full, so I stood next (4) ______ the door all the way. Still, I arrived at school just (5) ______ time for the first lesson.

passages.title: Afraid of Heights
passages.content:
My friend Dasha has always been afraid (1) ______ heights. Last summer she decided to do something (2) ______ it and signed up for a climbing course. At first she was nervous, but the instructor was very patient (3) ______ her.

After a month she climbed to the top of the wall, and she was really proud (4) ______ herself. Now she says she is interested (5) ______ trying real mountain climbing.

passages.title: The Village Festival
passages.content:
Every year (1) ______ August, our village holds a summer festival. People come from all (2) ______ the region to watch the parade and taste the local food.

This year the festival was cancelled (3) ______ the last minute because of a storm. Instead, it took place a week later, (4) ______ a sunny Sunday. (5) ______ the end of the day, more than two thousand people had visited.

passages.title: A Scientist Who Listens to Bees
passages.content:
Dr Hanna Kovalska has devoted twenty years (1) ______ the study of bees. She believes that beekeepers will soon depend (2) ______ the sounds inside a hive to spot problems early.

Her sensors are attached (3) ______ the outside of the hive, so they do not disturb the insects at all. Several farms have already signed contracts (4) ______ her company, and she is now working (5) ______ a phone app that turns the buzzing into simple warnings.

questions.title: The meeting is ___ Monday morning.
We usually go skiing ___ January.
The lesson starts ___ half past eight.
There is a bakery ___ the corner of our street.
questions.explanation: «On the corner» — усталений зворот про ріг вулиці.

questions.title: She put the letter ___ the drawer and locked it.
The cat jumped ___ the fence and ran away.
questions.explanation: «Over the fence» означає рух понад перешкодою.

questions.title: We travelled ___ Kyiv ___ Lviv by train.
I have been waiting ___ twenty minutes.
He has lived here ___ 2015.
The keys are ___ the table, next to the lamp.
She is very good ___ mathematics.
questions.explanation: «Good at» — усталене сполучення прикметника з прийменником.

questions.title: I am afraid ___ heights.
Which preposition follows the verb 'depend'?
We arrived ___ the airport two hours early.
questions.explanation: З аеропортом і вокзалом уживають «arrive at».

questions.title: Match each time expression with the preposition it takes.
questions.explanation: Прийменник часу залежить від того, наскільки конкретний період.

questions.title: Match each verb with the preposition that normally follows it.
questions.explanation: Кожне дієслово має свій сталий прийменник.

questions.title: Match each adjective with the preposition it takes.
Match each preposition of movement with the sentence it fits.
pairs: He ran out of the building.
The train went through a tunnel.

questions.title: The decision was taken ___ the recommendation of the committee.
questions.explanation: «On the recommendation of» — усталений формальний зворот.

questions.title: He is completely unaware ___ the difficulties ahead.
I congratulated her ___ passing the entrance exam.
questions.explanation: «Congratulate somebody on» вимагає прийменника «on» і герундія.

questions.title: They accused the supplier ___ breaking the contract.
The company invested heavily ___ renewable energy.
There is no substitute ___ regular practice.
Which sentence about prepositions contains a mistake?
options: She is married with a lawyer.
She is married to a lawyer.
She has been married for ten years.

questions.title: I am not familiar ___ that procedure.
The film differs greatly ___ the novel it is based on.
He apologised ___ me ___ arriving so late.
questions.explanation: «Apologise to somebody for something» вимагає двох прийменників.

questions.title: The results are broadly ___ line with our expectations.
questions.explanation: «In line with» — усталений зворот зі значенням «відповідно до».

questions.title: We discussed the proposal ___ length before voting.
She insisted ___ paying for the meal herself.
Match each verb with the dependent preposition it requires.
questions.explanation: Ці дієслова без свого прийменника змінюють або втрачають значення.

questions.title: Match each noun with the preposition that normally follows it.
questions.explanation: Кожен іменник має свій сталий прийменник.

questions.title: Match each fixed phrase with its meaning.
questions.explanation: Схожі на вигляд звороти означають зовсім різне.

questions.title: Match each pair of phrases with the difference in meaning.
pairs: hold the same view on it
questions.explanation: Прийменник після «agree» змінює зміст усього вислову.

questions.title: Match each faulty phrase with the correction it needs.
questions.explanation: Найтиповіші помилки — зайвий або невідповідний прийменник.

questions.title: The proposal was rejected ___ the grounds that it was too expensive.
questions.explanation: «On the grounds that» — формальний зворот зі значенням «на підставі того, що».

questions.title: Little progress has been made ___ respect to the funding gap.
questions.explanation: «With respect to» — формальний зворот зі значенням «щодо».

questions.title: The scheme was introduced ___ a view to reducing waste.
questions.explanation: «With a view to» вимагає герундія й означає мету.

questions.title: The findings are broadly consistent ___ earlier research.
Which formal phrase correctly signals an exception?
options: with the exception of the final chapter
with exception of the final chapter
in exception of the final chapter
by the exception of the final chapter
questions.explanation: «With the exception of» — формальний спосіб указати на виняток.

questions.title: The authorities acted ___ accordance with the new regulations.
questions.explanation: «In accordance with» — формальний зворот зі значенням «відповідно до».

questions.title: Match each formal prepositional phrase with its plain equivalent.
pairs: in the event of a delay
questions.explanation: Формальні прийменникові звороти мають прості відповідники.

questions.title: Match each academic phrase with the function it performs.
questions.explanation: Академічні звороти виконують у тексті чіткі логічні функції.

questions.title: Match each verb with the preposition that changes its meaning.
questions.explanation: Зміна прийменника після дієслова змінює напрямок причини й наслідку.
